entries.meaning: a fast alternation between a note and the note above it
a quick, single decoration: the main note, the note next to it, then the main note again
a four-note decoration: the note above, the main note, the note below, then the main note again
a very short grace note played just before the main note (shown with a slash through its stem)
a “leaning” grace note that takes some of the length of the main note
a small note that decorates the main note
